baseline.oracle_path_same_as_C3ff: root verified prior source comparison; not measurement relabeling

control_scope.actual_local_execution: Only Python byte/hash checks and a reverse git apply to a temporary copy. No Rust compilation, rustfmt, tests, native workload, scale/oracle DB replay or cost probe executed.
control_scope.old_controls: Original two projection unit methods remain exact; existing unchanged reference_spool tier/budget/error/ordering controls and integration 15-table tests remain applicable.

findings.conclusion: Text ValueRef is UTF8-validated to &str and serialized synchronously while the rusqlite Row remains borrowed. The per-row cells Vec is dropped before serialize_row returns its owned String; no borrowed data is retained in RowProjection.

Null, i64 and f64 use the same Value/json! conversion as the unchanged owned project function. This preserves signed-zero and nonfinite float encoding. Blob digest uses the same manifest::digest and serializes the same single blob_digest map entry. There is no direct f64-Serializer equivalence assumption.

The first successful row inserts keys in original column order into the actual serde_json::Map, then caches its keys order and each key last SELECT index. All column values are read before this selection, so overwritten invalid UTF8 or missing-column errors still occur. Existing partial Map state can contain only a prefix of this fixed layout and preserves the same first-insertion ordering. No hardcoded BTree-only serialization order.

get_ref, UTF8, scalar and blob work remain in original SELECT sequence. The final clear_values runs on both Result success and error, clearing prior owned projection values. Serialization errors remain errors, with no successful prefix result.

Original streaming caller performs count and input-row checks before this method; serialized length, cumulative bytes, scratch size and insertion transaction behavior are untouched. Per-row cells allocation is proportional to existing columns; cached indices are per-layout. Both complete source snapshots, all 15 tables, duplicate-preserving SQLite sort, Value equality, signed-zero ordering, and all digest comparisons are unchanged.

Ignored probe invokes the exact former streaming algorithm project -> to_string(reused Map) -> clear_values, not the fresh-map project_row variant. Five named finite synthetic SQLite cases have 256 rows each, one warmup per side and 20 alternating-order rounds. Full Vec bytes and digests are compared. Timings include SELECT traversal/serialization/retained output and exclude final digest calculation; no time threshold and no full-study performance claim.

limitations: Static acceptance is not proof of compilation or formatting; normal CI must execute the original and new Rust tests.
New Vec and scalar/digest allocations remain; no allocation-free claim.
No measured speedup or attribution of prior five-hour timeouts to this serialization path.
The cost workflow is authored separately by this reviewer and is not independently reviewed by this report; runtime peer reviews it.
